name: investment-analyst
description: Sweden-first equity research on free, keyless primary sources - no API keys, no paid feeds. Provenance, temporal validity and the decision's own arithmetic are enforced in code, not instructions. Sizes the position too: scenario distribution to fractional Kelly, then uncertainty, conviction ceiling, bear-case risk budget, liquidity and portfolio caps. TTM engine, valuation gate, validated decision record, thesis ledger, portfolio review. Screens Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki and Oslo.
